items.say: Hi. I'm Lumi. This one is just three short lines about your day.
text: One good thing, one thing you learned, and one thing for tomorrow.
Writing a small thing down helps you notice it. Good moments are easy to walk past, and a plan for tomorrow is lighter on paper than in your head.
A few words is plenty. Skip any line you like. What you write stays on this device, and nobody else reads it.
